insights.text: Aris Thessaloniki have won 5 of their 8 meetings against Volos NFC across all competitions.
Volos NFC's matches went over 2.5 goals in 4 of their last 5 fixtures across all competitions.
Both teams scored in 4 of Volos NFC's last 5 matches in Super League 1.
Volos NFC have scored in 6 consecutive matches across all competitions.
Both teams scored in 4 of the last 5 meetings between Aris Thessaloniki and Volos NFC across all competitions.
Aris Thessaloniki have failed to score in 3 consecutive matches in Super League 1.
Aris Thessaloniki won 6+ corners in 3 of their last 5 Super League 1 matches.
Volos NFC averages only 2 corners per match this season in Super League 1.
Aris Thessaloniki averaged 5.3 corners per match across their last 35 matches in all competitions.
Volos NFC conceded 5.8 corners per match across their last 5 games in all competitions.
Aris Thessaloniki have trailed at half-time in 2 of their last 3 Super League 1 matches.
Volos NFC have trailed at half-time in 3 of their last 5 Super League 1 matches.
Aris Thessaloniki's matches average 1.2 first-half goals in Super League 1.
Volos NFC have seen a first-half goal in 4 of their last 5 Super League 1 matches.
Aris Thessaloniki and Volos NFC have seen a first-half goal in 3 of their last 5 H2H meetings.
Aris Thessaloniki have conceded 0.8 first-half goals per match across their last 5 Super League 1 matches.
Volos NFC have conceded 0.8 first-half goals per match across their last 5 Super League 1 matches.
